text: This page takes the Executive from how much the company sold to where it sold, with a chart they can genuinely click through live, in the meeting.

DimTerritory's two real levels, region and individual territory, become a drill hierarchy on a clustered bar chart. Clicking a region bar expands straight into its territories, no rebuilding the visual.

Adding Percent of Company Total as a label turns raw dollars into real share-of-total context. This is the one place in the whole dashboard where the ALL-based company-wide benchmark actually earns its keep — every bar's percentage is computed against that same fixed denominator.
Next lesson publishes this dashboard and sets up its scheduled refresh, so it stays current the morning after every nightly warehouse load.
